name: Lodi
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Lodi Zinfandels are known as juicy and approachable.

blurb.text: A California Central Valley AVA at the northern edge of the San Joaquin Valley, in Sacramento and San Joaquin Counties. Its seven sub-areas include Alta Mesa, Borden Ranch and Mokelumne River.
